name: AWS
description: Amazon Web Services operates data centers to rent out computing power, storage, and/or software. The operator distinguishes itself through the broad service portfolio of platform services, ranging from serverless functions to hardware accelerators.

name: Megaport
description: Megaport is a network provider for on-demand layer two connectivity between data centers, cloud providers, and managed networks. Operators provision point-to-point connections adjust bandwidth through an API.

name: Oracle
description: Oracle's public cloud platform, offering compute, storage, networking, and database services with a focus on price-performance, security, and hybrid/multi-cloud interoperability.

name: Google
description: Google's public cloud offering, providing compute, storage, networking, data analytics, and AI/ML services built on Google's global infrastructure, with focus on data analytics, machine learning, and Kubernetes/container orchestration.

name: Cloudflare
description: Google's public cloud offering, providing compute, storage, networking, data analytics, and AI/ML services built on Google's global infrastructure, with particular strengths in data analytics, machine learning, and Kubernetes/container orchestration.

name: Twilio
description: Twilio is a cloud communications platform providing APIs for SMS, voice, video, email, and messaging (including WhatsApp), letting developers embed communication features directly into their applications.

name: Slack
description: Slack is a cloud-based team collaboration platform offering channel-based messaging, file sharing, and integrations with third-party tools, used primarily for internal workplace communication.

name: Azure
description: Microsoft's public cloud platform, offering compute, storage, networking, and database services alongside deep integration with Microsoft's enterprise ecosystem (Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Windows Server), with particular strengths in hybrid cloud, enterprise IT, and AI services.
